talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 52 solo PCPs winding down in North Carolina; 6 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Raleigh 27612, Elizabeth City 27909, Matthews 28105) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~7,169 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Harnett County, Richmond County, Yadkin County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 25 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~120,000 patients across 100 at-risk practices statewide.
